scientific_integrity: All 4,037,913 base permutations of sizes one through ten were checked by two integer-arithmetic formulations in a standalone reproduced executable, and the all-larger-size step is an explicit combinatorial argument. No independence is claimed.
scientific_limitations: The sharp threshold and five-orbit classification are exhaustively certified only through base length ten; persistence is proved for constructed examples, not a full classification above ten. Historical originality is provisional, and independent audit has not been performed.
title: The sharp ten-parameter failure of unimodality for two-order singleton disagreement spectra
